path: `BRIEF.md` flagged the contradiction on 2026-08-31 and it is still open (`docs/PRODUCT-BRIEF.md:231`).

recCase: The commit record is the only evidence either way, and it says one person twice over (`docs/PRODUCT-BRIEF.md:231`).
